issues.reason: The head genus is suppressed when the IS-A fails ('a hot dog is not a dog'), and a sand-glass is not a kind of glass — neither the vessel nor the material — so (Inheritance sand_glass glass) would put a false atom in the KB; the 'rainshadow -> shadow' clause the issue cites only bars treating a solid spelling as a reason to skip a genus whose IS-A does hold.

gaps_confirmed: equative copular with a DEFINITE predicate nominal ('A sand-glass ... is the village's clock'): identity / uniqueness has no carrier, so the definite predicate survives only as a plain class atom plus the genitive's Possession
new_gaps: an indefinite subject in a copular clause that must be read specifically (a locative restriction plus a definite predicate nominal): Existential states that 'a/an' is generic in a copular / definitional predication and gives no stated exception for the specific reading the definite predicate forces
notes: Every emitted atom is true and well-typed: 'the Watch' takes the capitalized-common-noun default, entity-attached containment routes to LocatedIn, and the predicate's genitive attaches to the subject symbol rather than minting a second clock witness.
